description_en: Updates the rules of a lifecycle policy. This operation is supported only for CPFS for AI file systems. The `UpdateLifecyclePolicy` operation overwrites the entire policy. Omitting an optional parameter deletes its corresponding configuration. To add a rule to an existing policy, call the `DescribeLifecyclePolicies` operation to retrieve the current policy, append the new rule, and then call `UpdateLifecyclePolicy` with the updated configuration
description_zh:
更新一个生命周期管理策略的规则。仅智算 CPFS 支持。

UpdateLifecyclePolicy 是覆盖语义，非必选参数为空则表示删除对应字段。当您需要追加生命周期规则时，请先调用 DescribeLifecyclePolicies 接口获取当前生命周期规则配置，然后追加新的生命周期规则配置，最后调用 UpdateLifecyclePolicy 接口更新生命周期规则配置
kebab_example: aliyun nas update-lifecycle-policy --file-system-id bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64y00000 --storage-type InfrequentAccess --lifecycle-policy-id lsp-bp1234567890ab0000 --description Lifecycle_policy_description --paths /path1 --transit-rules Attribute=Atime Threshold=3 --retrieve-rules Attribute=RetrieveType Threshold=All --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.description_en:

The description must be 3 to 64 characters long and must start with a letter. It can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

> This parameter is supported only for CPFS for AI file systems.

>仅 CPFS 智算版支持。

element_fields.description_en:
The retrieval method. Valid values:

- If `Attribute` is set to `RetrieveType`:

  - `AfterVisit`: Retrieves data on a best-effort basis after a file is accessed. This value is valid only when `LifecyclePolicyType` is `Auto`.

  - `All`: Retrieves all data. This value is valid only when `LifecyclePolicyType` is `OnDemand`.
element_fields.description_zh:

    - All:  LifecyclePolicyType=OnDemand 支持，代表取回所有
